## Authentication
Custom Header (x-fsign) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Data Read (6)
- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific item by its ID.
- `GET /20/x/feed/{feedId}` — Fetch data from a specific Flashscore PT feed.
- `GET /api/v1/banners` — Get banner information for display on Flashscore PT.
- `GET /fs/api/v2/font` — Get font data for rendering the Flashscore PT website.
- `GET /futebol/portugal/liga-portugal-betclic/{liga-portugal-betclicId}/` — Get data for a specific Portuguese football league.
- `GET /odds/pq_graphql` — Query odds data using a GraphQL endpoint.

### Media (1)
- `GET /{id}/api/image/optimize` — Retrieve an optimized image by its ID.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Flashscore Pt's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Flashscore Pt data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.flashscore.pt (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Flashscore Pt frontend uses
